gen-press-start-2p-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Press Start 2P spaces its letters far apart like cut-out shapes, with a faint thick-thin play you only notice up close. Big and short is its home, and Anek Gurmukhi carries the rest.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-anek-kannada: Letters spaced far apart like cut-out shapes mark Press Start 2P, with only a moderate thick-thin shift. Anek Kannada, a plain sans with high x-height and terminals held off the stem, keeps long text moving.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-anek-latin: Press Start 2P brings a fun, retro look, with letters pinned far apart and only a modest weight shift in its curves. It grabs attention, while Anek Latin holds its rounds open for steady reading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam reads clean and contemporary, with capitals sitting close to the lowercase and curve tips that never touch. Press Start 2P adds the fun, retro spacing, leaving Anek Malayalam to carry the long text.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-anek-odia: Wide-spaced letters like cut-out shapes define Press Start 2P, with stems just slightly thicker than the strokes joining them. Anek Odia keeps its rounds unsealed, a quiet partner for that loud spacing.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-anek-telugu: Letters pinned far apart give Press Start 2P its retro swagger. Anek Telugu brings wide, tall bowls and unsealed rounds, a sans partner that keeps the fun approachable.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-arimo: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with thick-thin play as restrained as a worn wooden stamp. Arimo, a sans-serif with a tall mean line and open terminals, makes lengthy text feel unhurried.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-athiti: Letters pinned far apart like cut-outs make Press Start 2P unmistakable, with moderate swelling along each line. But shrink it and the wide gaps feel lost, whereas Athiti keeps a single line width.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart, with a measured weight difference like thread against yarn. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono lets open counters breathe beside that spacing.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next reads with big lowercase eyes and unsealed rounds. Press Start 2P is best at loud, spaced-out display lines, while the sans quietly handles the reading.
